brief:
An Israeli attempt to assassinate Ali al-Amoudi, deputy head of Hamas's political bureau in Gaza, has failed, according to Israeli army radio, Middle East Eye reported. The operation targeted one of the militant group's senior political leaders.

Details of the failed strike remain limited. No statement has been issued regarding the circumstances of the attempt or whether there were casualties in the operation.
dek: Report: Israeli attempt to kill senior Hamas official fails Israeli army radio said an attempt to assassinate Ali al-Amoudi, the deputy head of Hamas’s political bureau in Gaza, had failed.
title: Israeli strike on Hamas deputy chief in Gaza fails
